description: What every platform listings parser must return for each listings sample and valid fixture. Same rules as app-config.expected.json: match `expected`, or differ only in a field named in that platform's knownDrift entry.

items.meaning: Number of listings the parser returns (no item is dropped: every item in these files is valid).

ids.meaning: Listing ids as text, in order.

nullRemoteUrlIds.meaning: Ids whose remote_url is JSON null. Parsers must treat it as absent (never the text "null").

knownDrift.flutter: items: SellwildListing.fromJson hard-casts shippable/price/strikePrice/id as String? and throws on 10 item(s) (bool shippable or numeric price), and fetchListings has no per-item guard, so the whole feed fails.
